8272.title: Unscoped client signals cross thread subscriptions
8272.rootCauseOneLine: Open and pane commands use a hub-wide socket broadcast without a recipient, independent of thread subscriptions.
8272.proposedFix: Define recipient identity and routing policy across request and socket boundaries before implementing isolation; no simple fix is safe.
8272.caveats: Real HTTP/WebSocket delivery reproduced twice; browser navigation and authenticated multi-person isolation were not executed because Chrome is unavailable. Complete reproduction tests are inline.
